component.name: QuMesh
component.summary: Native Qt6 console for Intel AMT (vPro) devices

description.p: QuMesh manages Intel AMT (vPro) hardware over WSMAN and the Intel redirection protocol. It is a native Qt6 successor to Intel's NW.js-based MeshCommander, removing the embedded Chromium runtime and the 1.1 GB application bundle that came with it.

ul.li: WSMAN client — connect, inventory, power control, event log.
Serial-over-LAN terminal (VT100) over the Intel redirection channel.
IDE-R — mount a local ISO as a remote drive on the AMT host.
Certificate store with pinning and mutual-TLS hooks.
One-shot import of configurations saved by the legacy NW.js MeshCommander.
